mentions.name: docking.cc
mentions.description: A Linux dock bar that runs on Wayland and X11, with support for FreeBSD, OpenBSD, and NetBSD, and Windows support being experimented with. It ships with 60+ native applets such as WhatsApp, Hacker News, Reddit, Calendar, and Weather.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://docking.cc is a Linux dock bar with Wayland, X11, Linux, Free/Open/NetBSD and experimenting on Windows

It has 60+ native applets like WhatsApp, Hacker News, Reddit, Calendar, Weather, ...
